articles.headline: The players who played no minutes at the World Cup -- who were the unlucky few?
articles.description: The World Cup was a time to remember for most, for a handful of players though, their time at the tournament was merely sitting in the best seats in the house.

articles.headline: Lamine Yamal explains Lionel Messi advice after World Cup final, says it was as valuable as a medal
articles.description: Lionel Messi encouraged Lamine Yamal "to go his own way" in the immediate aftermath of Spain's win over Argentina in the World Cup final.

articles.headline: ESPN's outrageous, fanciful, way too early African XI for the 2030 FIFA World Cup
articles.description: ESPN have taken on the foolish task of predicting the African continent's best XI for the 2030 FIFA World Cup in four years' time.

articles.headline: Spain's Gavi: Argentina players shouldn't be punished for World Cup final fracas
articles.description: Spain midfielder Gavi said he believes Argentina players should not be punished by FIFA for their actions after Sunday's World Cup final.

articles.headline: Grading Africa's FIFA World Cup teams, plus one key question for each team going forward
articles.description: With the FIFA World Cup in the books after six long weeks, and Spain emerging victorious over Argentina in the final, it's time to reflect on what was an historic tournament for Africa.

articles.headline: 10 African stars who caught transfer scouts' eyes at the FIFA World Cup
articles.description: Every four years, the FIFA World Cup reshapes the transfer landscape, offering players the opportunity to showcase their qualities against elite opposition in front of the watching world.
